Trädkontoret AB is an independent consultancy specializing in urban forestry, urban greening, and nature-based solutions. The company supports municipalities, public authorities, property owners, and infrastructure projects across Scandinavia with expert services related to urban trees, green infrastructure, climate adaptation, biodiversity, and ecosystem services.
Our work includes tree inventories, risk assessments, tree protection planning, strategic urban forest management, policy development, GIS-based analyses, and research-driven decision support. Trädkontoret also participates in national and international research and innovation projects focused on resilient cities, environmental sustainability, and the integration of nature-based solutions into urban planning.
With offices in Sweden, Norway, and Denmark, Trädkontoret combines scientific expertise with practical experience to help clients develop sustainable, climate-resilient, and biodiversity-rich urban environments.

Island Oil Holdings is a diversified group of companies that primarily deals with the supply and trading of marine fuels. The group has physical supply stations in Cyprus, Romania, and Israel, along with trading desks in Piraeus, Singapore, London, Hong Kong, Seoul and Dubai.

Today, Island Oil is a respected supplier in the global bunker market. This has been achieved through a genuine client-oriented approach, strong financial management, controlled growth, and a highly skilled and trained team of professionals.

description:
Inspirators! is an Estonian AI and data company developing LLM, agentic AI and industrial automation solutions for engineering-heavy sectors. Our tools turn technical documents, drawings and digital twin data into actionable knowledge, BOMs and pricing insights. We are a member of the Cooperants space ecosystem and contribute to the ESA European Space Agency Digital Twin SpaceCraft project.

Inspirators! is addressing one of the key bottlenecks in European manufacturing: the slow and manual preparation of quotations and bills of materials. Its AI-powered Automatic BOM & Preliminary Pricing module helps manufacturers extract relevant information from technical drawings, specifications and customer requests, generate structured BOMs and support preliminary price estimation. This enables faster quotation cycles, better use of engineering capacity and improved competitiveness for companies in metalworking, contract manufacturing, shipbuilding and industrial equipment sectors.

entityDescription:
Natural Synergies Ltd (NS) was established in May 2012 as a technology development company aiming to develop and commercially establish specific aspects of renewable energy, environment and sustainable engineering technologies.NS has been awarded grants through the UK Department of Energy & Climate Change (DECC), Innovate UK and by the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation (BMGF), leading to pre-commercialisation testing of two specific innovative technologies that can operate independently or synergistically. 
1 Natural Synergies–Advanced Thermophilic Anaerobic Digestion (NS-ATAD) was developed through grants received form DECC, Innovate-UK, for utilising biomass wastes, proven on wetland biomass and human wastewater (primary sludge) at a UK wastewater treatment plant. NS-ATAD plant is particularly designed for operation and use in both developing and developed countries.
2 NS has further developed, with funding by BMGF (Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation) and Innovate UK, a faecal sludge, animal slurry and wastewater dewatering and sanitation patented technology called NS-SONEK which will be engineered and manufactured in the UK and shipped to various countries for use as an independent system or integrated into any existing or new AD plant. Most of the components of NS-SONEK can be built and installed in most developing countries. 
NS team consists of a number of experienced technology innovators: 
Victoria Melchor (B.Eng., MSc.) 
a commercially focused innovator, experienced in environmental and biological innovative process and plant development and design, commissioning & operations. 
Faisal Salam (PhD, MEI, CEng)
has experience in innovative development and commercialisation in AD, combustion, gasification and solar based RE system. 
NS retains at its core all intellectual property (IP) rights and know-how in its developments of NS-SONEK and NS-ATAD. 
NS will seek to establish a working relationship and/or joint venture with established organisations and it is envisaged that this co-operation could be developed into technology roll-out delivery company.

entityDescription:
About OneEpsilon
OneEpsilon is a specialist provider of engineering services and consultancy, delivering advanced technical solutions across a broad range of industries and applications. Our core capabilities include:
Multi-Physics Simulation
We possess deep expertise in the application of Finite Element Analysis (FEA), Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), and Discrete Element Methods (DEM) to complex engineering challenges. Our team is experienced in developing conjugate simulation models that integrate multiple physical domains within a single framework — including thermal-structural analysis, fluid-structure interaction, and flow-acoustics.
Data Science & Technical Software Development
We apply data science and machine learning techniques to engineering environments where datasets are often sparse or complex. Our specific capabilities include surrogate model development, digital twin solutions for condition-based lifing, and the application of ML methods to capture and codify institutional knowledge within intelligent software tools.
Design & Optimisation
Our in-house design capability, combined with our simulation and data science expertise, enables us to take concepts from initial design through development and qualification — delivering optimised engineering solutions with a rigorous analytical foundation.
Industry Experience
OneEpsilon operates across a wide range of sectors, including Aerospace, Oil & Gas, Food & Beverage Manufacturing, Industrial, Energy, Nuclear, and Motorsport.

entityDescription:
Arcane Aerospace Inc. is a Canadian space technology company developing capabilities to defend and protect spacecraft from attack in orbit. The company is building a mass-manufacturable spacecraft bus designed to host a wide range of payloads, with the same platform, hardware, and software supporting both defence and civil missions depending on the payload it carries. This gives Arcane a dual-use foundation across applications including space defence and space control, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR), Earth observation and other hosted payloads.
The company is led by one of the most flight-experienced teams in the Canadian space sector, with two founders who have contributed to more than 50 rocket launches between them, alongside depth in spacecraft operations, autonomous systems, and robotics, including the integration of AI into physical platforms. Arcane is currently designing and building its first spacecraft, a 100 kg platform (V0), targeting a Q2 2027 launch on a SpaceX Transporter mission. Its work is supported by Canadian government innovation funding, including PacifiCan's RDII program.

entityDescription:
The PLANES Lab advances ecosystem services knowledge to improve real-life decisions, with a focus on urban and spatial planning, land-use policies, climate adaptation strategies and environmental design. Our research is grounded in sustainability science and brings together different fields, such as landscape ecology, planning theory, spatial analysis and impact assessment theory and practice.
We conduct inter-disciplinary and mostly empirical research, often in collaboration with local stakeholders. Our current study areas range from European cities to Alpine nature parks, and from temperate regions in South-America to urban watersheds in the Horn of Africa and landscapes/seascapes in the EU Overseas. In these areas we address a variety of challenges, including climate change, nature conservation, urban regeneration, urban sprawl, tourism development, and infrastructure siting.

Its delivery capacity is provided by SES and its four owner companies - covering IT and IoT infrastructure, enterprise/solution/data architecture, system integration, delivery management and quality assurance - complemented by a long-term senior freelance expert pool, giving a combined core team of multiplespecialists.

entityDescription: YAPE is an autonomous systems technology company developing a modular, vehicle-agnostic software platform for off-highway, robotic and special-purpose vehicles. The company provides an autonomy layer that enables machines to perceive their environment, navigate, follow planned paths, operate remotely, exchange data, and evolve toward semi-autonomous or autonomous operation. YAPE’s technology can be integrated into different types of vehicles and robotic platforms, including agricultural machines, urban service vehicles, industrial mobility systems and specialized autonomous platforms. Its value lies in the reusable autonomy stack, which combines perception, navigation, control, connectivity and diagnostics in a scalable software architecture. This modular approach makes YAPE suitable for applications where autonomous mobility, remote operation, environmental perception and reliable machine control are required in complex or constrained environments.

entityDescription:
Invenco Engineering: Advanced Mechanical Engineering and Simulation for High-Reliability Space Systems
Invenco Engineering is a Polish SME offering specialized mechanical engineering and advanced computer-aided simulation services. With over two decades of expertise, we have cultivated a robust design and analysis methodology in safety-critical applications, where structural integrity, reliability, and performance in extreme environments are paramount. Our legacy in demanding terrestrial transport sectors has provided a strong foundation for addressing the unique challenges of the space industry.
Our engineering philosophy is rooted in a Finite Element Analysis (FEA) driven process, rigorously validated against experimental test data for static, dynamic, and fatigue loads. 
Core Competencies for Space Applications
Our expertise is directly transferable to the design and verification of space systems, including satellite structures, launcher components, and ground support equipment.
- Structural Analysis and Design for Extreme Environments: We possess deep expertise in the conceptual and detailed design of steels, aluminum alloys and layered composite structures. Our analysis capabilities cover the full spectrum of space mission load cases, from ground handling and launch to in-orbit operations.
- Launch Vehicle Vibration and Fatigue Analysis: We specialize in vibration engineering, including the analysis of structures subjected to the intense random vibration loads experienced during launch. Our fatigue analysis capabilities (compliant with rigorous standards like FKM) are essential for predicting the lifespan of components subjected to mechanical and thermal cycling.
- Shock, Impact, and High-Energy Dynamic Events: Our extensive background in crashworthiness, plasticity and failure, utilizing explicit dynamics codes like LS-Dyna or Radioss, translates directly to the analysis of a various critical space events. 
- Component and Joint Integrity: We provide detailed analysis of critical structural connections. Our proficiency in codified methodologies for bolted joint analysis (VDI 2230) ensures the reliability of fastened joints, a common point of failure in complex assemblies. This rigorous approach is readily adaptable to ESA's ECSS standards.
- Advanced CAE and Multiphysics Simulation: Our competencies extend across a range of CAE fields crucial for space applications:
- Thermal and Thermo-elastic analysis for components subjected to extreme temperature gradients.
- Mechanical systems analysis for mechanisms and deployable structures.
- Large and complex assembly management and DFMEA analysis to ensure system-level reliability.
- Advanced CAD Design using industry-standards.
R&D and Custom Tool Development
Beyond standard analysis, Invenco possesses an in-house team dedicated to advanced algorithmics and programming (Python, C, C++). This unique capability allows us to develop specialized, proprietary engineering tools to solve non-standard problems, automate complex analysis workflows, and support R&D activities with bespoke software solutions. Core specialy of the team is computer vision and alghoritms for mechanical engineering.

entityName: ASOCIACIÓN DE INVESTIGACIÓN DE LAS INDUSTRIAS CERÁMICAS-ITC
entityDescription:
ITC-AICE is a technology institute with more than five decades of experience, recognised as a pioneer in fostering collaboration between universities and industry. It plays a key role in driving innovation, sustainability, and digital transformation in the ceramic sector and related industries, through applied research and close cooperation with companies at both national and international levels.
The institute has strong expertise in the development and manufacturing of advanced ceramic materials, particularly for high-performance applications such as aerospace and defense. Its core strengths include deep knowledge of material design, processing, and industrial implementation, as well as advanced capabilities in forming, sintering, post-processing, and comprehensive material characterization. This allows ITC to optimise material performance and ensure scalability for real-world applications.
In addition, ITC specialises in the development of advanced materials with tailored thermal andmechanical properties for structural and functional applications. These solutions are designed for components required to operate under extreme conditions of temperature, mechanical load and aggressive environments, maintaining their structural and functional integrity alongside low weight. Its work includes precise control of raw materials through colloidal chemistry and powder processing, as well as the engineering of lightweight and highly resistant ceramic solutions. These capabilities are supported by innovative manufacturing approaches, including additive manufacturing technologies such as binder jetting, fused filament fabrication, and digital light processing, enabling the production of complex and efficient components.
The centre also develops functional coatings and advanced carbon-based materials through high-temperature graphitisation processes, contributing to applications such as electromagnetic shielding and signal absorption. Its activities are supported by cutting-edge scientific infrastructure and a multidisciplinary team that integrates expertise in materials science, processing, simulation, and data analysis, ensuring a comprehensive and application-oriented approach.
Finally, ITC stands out for its strong commitment to innovation and technology transfer, with extensive experience in collaborative R&D projects, including dual-use initiatives. Its portfolio of patents and technological developments, especially in additive manufacturing and advanced ceramic systems, reinforces its position as a leading centre for the development of high-value technological solutions.

description:
Rinnoco LTD is a research, innovation, and education company, which enables the development of new unique products from design to deployment targeting international markets.

Founded in 2021, Rinnoco is a startup company based in Limassol, Cyprus, with unique expertise due to its broad experienced team in both academic and industry. The founders of the company have over 30 years of diverse research experience, including SQL and NoSQL databases, big data and data streams, spatiotemporal systems, mobile computing, sensor networks and internet of things (IoT), machine learning applications, quantum mechanics, and significant scientific contributions published in international top-tier conferences and scientific journals.

Rinnoco LTD’s vision is to become the first of the kind company in Cyprus, which develops state-of-the-art data management techniques and provides novel data management tools that can boost the productivity, profitability, and scalability of local and international companies.

entityDescription:
RSOE is committed to give rise to the information society therefore it does its best to make the technological innovations widespread public. It safeguards and fears for the natural and built environment, and in order to protect it RSOE uses the most modern technologies, the help of the global navigation satellite system (GNSS) and the geographic information system (GIS), especially in the field of inland navigation and disaster management. The Association also through its proposals and projects supports the European integration and cohesion, in terms of the principles of regionality, partnership and transparency. RSOE develops and keeps a wide spectrum of European and international relations, presenting the Hungarian innovation.

The National Association of Radio Distress-Signalling and Infocommunications was established in 1982. Currently, as a prominently public benefit organization, the Association in cooperation particularly with governmental administrations or rather with organizations which the latter have control over implement those activities, with that according to the relating regulations and agreements it constantly supports the work of the governmental sphere. Besides this the Association pays accentuated attention to the tasks of Hungary steamed from its EU membership, therefore RSOE with its international partners constantly takes part in different national and other projects co-financed by the EU.

Main professional areas of the Association’s is to operate and develop river information services and port management system in Hungary (www.pannonris.hu). By virtue of the contract signed with the ministry responsible for transport, RIS in Hungary is provided by RSOE. Operation and development of information and emergency systems. To ensure the order and safety on national waters RSOE operates different information and emergency systems on the Danube, Tisza rivers and Lake Balaton.
RSOE through its proposals and projects supports the European integration and cohesion, therefore also in the field of disaster managements and river information services writes tender applications with its partners for support from the European Union, in order to study, implement and test new professional ideas. Thanks to the several successful projects the Association gained many experience and references. About our projects more information can be found on this page.

entityDescription:
VMEL International is a software development and technology consulting company based in Limassol, Cyprus, working with clients across Europe and worldwide. We build custom software, modernise legacy systems, design cloud architecture, and advise on system design and technology strategy.
We develop agentic AI platforms and AI agents, including multi-agent systems, LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and intelligent automation built on OpenAI, Claude, and Mistral. We also offer human-led agentic software development, using AI coding agents to speed up delivery while our engineers keep control of architecture, security, and quality.
Our backend work covers Java, Go, Node.js, and TypeScript, with microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, REST and GraphQL APIs, and real-time systems. For web and mobile we use React, Next.js, Angular, Vue.js, and React Native, alongside native iOS and Android with Flutter and/or Capacitor. We run cloud-native workloads on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD, backed by PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, and Redis.
Our project experience covers fintech, payments, e-money, SaaS, e-commerce, real estate, and on-demand platforms, with a focus on high-availability, scalable, and secure systems, including PCI-DSS compliance, test automation, and agile delivery.

entityDescription:
Founded in 1983 and part of the Trefin Group, 3F&EDIN was established as a software house specializing in the Industry, Defence, and Banking & Insurance sectors. Over the years, the company has continuously expanded its expertise, establishing itself as a qualified technology partner.
The company operates in software development and the implementation of innovative Artificial Intelligence-based solutions, supporting organizations in their digital transformation journey and in the optimization of decision-making and operational processes. Throughout its history, 3F&EDIN has developed advanced expertise across several AI application domains, including Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Predictive Analytics, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Computer Vision.
Its core offerings include data analytics and decision-support platforms, intelligent systems for business process automation, chatbots and virtual assistants aimed at enhancing customer experience, as well as predictive models for preventive maintenance, risk management, and resource optimization. Particular attention is given to the integration of AI technologies with existing information systems, collaborative robots (cobots), drones, and UAV platforms, ensuring solutions characterized by scalability, security, and reliability.
Through a customer-oriented approach, 3F&EDIN develops tailored solutions designed to address the specific requirements of each operational environment, generating tangible value in terms of operational efficiency, cost reduction, and performance improvement. The company supports customers throughout the entire lifecycle of IT projects, from requirements analysis and technology assessment to solution selection, implementation, deployment, and the provision of maintenance, support, and continuous improvement services.
